We will chemically clean and disinfect your tank to remove all of the bacteria, mold, algae, sludge and sediment and almost all of the staining inside the tank. The tanks will be cleaned and disinfected as per Municipality standards and guidelines using appropriate environmental friendly chemicals approved by Municipality. The water tanks will be cleaned and disinfected by spraying chemicals on the inner surface of the tanks. Stains, sediment and mold will be removed with the help of brushes. The tanks will then be thoroughly rinsed with fresh water and checked for pH neutral before allowing them for refilling.
